[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Peter Glasgow certified on 26 March 1789 that his uncle John Glasgow had lived at his house about twenty-seven years and had died intestate. Peter asked for administration to go to John Taylor, whom he called his sister’s son. The certificate identifies an uncle–nephew family but names neither Peter’s father nor his sister.<ref>Chester County Register of Wills, original file 4015, West Nottingham, 1789, volume 03901–4050, portal pp. 1060–1066; Peter’s certificate p. 1065. [https://portal.laserfiche.com/Portal/DocView.aspx?id=772934&page=1065&repo=r-24f48cc6 Official original]. Images inspected 23 October 2026.</ref>
